This is my barley plot, and I have farmed it for many years. I will put some DAP and urea like always — not the full government recommendation because cash is tight, but enough to give the crop a push. I keep cattle, so I spread some manure too before ploughing. For seed I use what I saved from last harvest — improved barley is hard to find in our area and the local kind grows well enough. My family will do most of the work with our oxen, but at harvest time I may call a neighbor or two to help cut quickly before the rains spoil the grain.
